youtube.title: Why You Can't Tickle Yourself 🤭 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Try to tickle yourself right now. Nothing happens.

Your brain knows exactly what your own hand is about to do. A part at the back of your brain predicts the touch and turns the feeling down. Tickling needs surprise. And you can't surprise yourself. Scientists built a robot that tickled people with their own hand, but with a tiny delay. Just a fraction of a second late, and it started to tickle again. So the tickle was never in your skin. It's in the surprise.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
